leitfaden.phase.1.chat: ❄ The Christmas project begins! Press L for your quest book.
leitfaden.phase.3.chat: ☃ Christmas week! Build whatever you like, together if you want.
leitfaden.phase.4.chat: ★ The End is open! We fight the dragon together, date in chat.
questbuch.ankommen.abenteuer.schritt.1: Wait for night or enter a dark cave.
questbuch.ankommen.abenteuer.schritt.2: Take a weapon and hit a mob until it is defeated.
questbuch.ankommen.abenteuer.schritt.3: If you die: no drama, you respawn at your bed or spawn.
questbuch.ankommen.abenteuer.tipp: A sword helps. So does running away.
questbuch.ankommen.abenteuer.tun: Kill something or get killed. One of the two is bound to happen.
questbuch.ankommen.abflug.schritt.1: Stand on the spawn island and jump.
questbuch.ankommen.abflug.schritt.2: Jump again in mid-air and the elytra opens.
questbuch.ankommen.abflug.schritt.3: Press F for a boost and fly off.
questbuch.ankommen.abflug.schritt.4: The elytra is only on loan, so land gently.
questbuch.ankommen.abflug.tipp: Press F for a boost. The elytra is only on loan for this flight.
questbuch.ankommen.abflug.tun: Double-jump on the spawn island and you glide off with an elytra.
questbuch.ankommen.andenken.tipp: Genuine Christmas gingerbread. Edible, but far too nice to eat.
questbuch.ankommen.andenken.tun: Finish every ★ quest in this chapter.
questbuch.ankommen.beschreibung: Your first days on the server. Every quest ticks itself off.
questbuch.ankommen.bett.schritt.1: Shear or kill sheep and collect 3 wool of the same colour.
questbuch.ankommen.bett.schritt.2: Lay 3 wool above 3 planks at the crafting table.
questbuch.ankommen.bett.schritt.3: Place the bed and right-click it in the evening.
questbuch.ankommen.bett.schritt.4: It sets your respawn point. Without a bed you land at spawn.
questbuch.ankommen.bett.tipp: Sleeping skips the night and sets your respawn point. Without a bed you respawn at spawn.
Look at the block you want to mark.
Press the period key to mark it.
Press the comma key to switch profile.
Adjust everything else via Mod Menu.
questbuch.ankommen.block_marker.tipp: Adjust everything via Mod Menu. Block Marker needs the modpack.
questbuch.ankommen.block_marker.tun: Comma switches the profile, period marks the block you are looking at.
questbuch.ankommen.eisen.fundort.1: Iron is most common at heights of about -24 to 56.
questbuch.ankommen.eisen.fundort.2: High up in the mountains there is plenty more iron, from height 80.
questbuch.ankommen.eisen.schritt.1: Mine iron ore with the stone pickaxe: it drops raw iron.
questbuch.ankommen.eisen.schritt.2: Put 8 cobblestone in a ring around an empty slot: that's a furnace.
questbuch.ankommen.eisen.schritt.3: Put raw iron on top and fuel at the bottom of the furnace.
questbuch.ankommen.eisen.schritt.4: Wait a moment and take out the iron ingot.
questbuch.ankommen.eisen.tipp: Iron ore hides in caves and on mountainsides.
questbuch.ankommen.eisen.tun: Build a furnace and smelt raw iron into an iron ingot.
questbuch.ankommen.eisenspitzhacke.schri: Smelt 3 raw iron into iron ingots.
Lay out 3 iron ingots and 2 sticks like a pickaxe at the crafting table.
With it you can mine diamonds, gold and redstone.
questbuch.ankommen.eisenspitzhacke.tipp: You need it to mine diamonds, gold and redstone.
questbuch.ankommen.essen.schritt.1: Kill an animal like a cow or pig. It drops meat.
questbuch.ankommen.essen.schritt.2: Cook the meat in a furnace: it fills you up far more.
questbuch.ankommen.essen.schritt.3: Hold right-click until you finish eating.
questbuch.ankommen.essen.schritt.4: Apples from oak leaves work in a pinch.
questbuch.ankommen.essen.tipp: Cooked meat fills you up far more than raw. Apples drop from oak leaves.
questbuch.ankommen.fackeln.schritt.1: Mine coal ore or smelt logs in a furnace to get charcoal.
questbuch.ankommen.fackeln.schritt.2: Put coal or charcoal above a stick: you get 4 torches.
questbuch.ankommen.fackeln.schritt.3: Place a torch on the ground or on a wall.
questbuch.ankommen.fackeln.tipp: Monsters spawn in the dark. Smelt logs in a furnace to get charcoal.
questbuch.ankommen.freier_fall.schritt.1: Fill a bucket with water and climb to the build limit.
questbuch.ankommen.freier_fall.schritt.2: Jump and fall all the way down, ideally over a lake.
questbuch.ankommen.freier_fall.schritt.3: Place the water right before you land to soften the fall.
questbuch.ankommen.freier_fall.schritt.4: Please don't practise over lava. It only ends in smoke.
questbuch.ankommen.freier_fall.tipp: Place the water right before you land. Please don't practise over lava.
questbuch.ankommen.freier_fall.tun: Fall from the build limit all the way to the bottom and survive.
questbuch.ankommen.karte.schritt.1: Press M to open the world map.
questbuch.ankommen.karte.schritt.2: Press B to set a waypoint at your home.
questbuch.ankommen.karte.schritt.3: Press F3 and note down your coordinates.
questbuch.ankommen.karte.tipp: Note down where your home is. The map hides caves on purpose. Map and waypoints need the modpack.
questbuch.ankommen.karte.tun: M opens the world map, B sets a waypoint, F3 shows your coordinates.
questbuch.ankommen.lava.schritt.1: Craft a bucket from 3 iron ingots in a V shape.
questbuch.ankommen.lava.schritt.2: Find a lava pool, best deep underground.
questbuch.ankommen.lava.schritt.3: Stand safely and scoop the lava with right-click.
questbuch.ankommen.lava.schritt.4: Never dig straight down, or it gets hot.
questbuch.ankommen.lava.tipp: Never dig straight down! A lava bucket is great furnace fuel.
questbuch.ankommen.monster.schritt.1: Make a stone sword from 2 cobblestone and 1 stick.
questbuch.ankommen.monster.schritt.2: Wait for night and zombies and skeletons show up on their own.
questbuch.ankommen.monster.schritt.3: Hit the monster and back off when your hearts run low.
questbuch.ankommen.monster.schritt.4: Keep your back to a wall so nothing comes from behind.
questbuch.ankommen.monster.tipp: Zombies and skeletons come out at night. Keep your back to a wall.
questbuch.ankommen.pfeil.brauchst: Bow: 3 sticks, 3 string. Arrows: flint, stick, feather
questbuch.ankommen.pfeil.schritt.1: Collect 3 string from spiders and 3 sticks.
questbuch.ankommen.pfeil.schritt.2: Lay them out as a bow at the crafting table.
questbuch.ankommen.pfeil.schritt.3: Craft arrows from flint, stick and feather.
questbuch.ankommen.pfeil.schritt.4: Hold right-click to draw, release to shoot.
questbuch.ankommen.pfeil.tipp: String comes from spiders, feathers from chickens, flint from gravel.
Powder snow lies on snowy slopes.
Lay out 4 leather as boots and put them on.
Find snowy slopes with powder snow. It looks like normal snow.
Walk across it in the boots without sinking.
questbuch.ankommen.pulverschnee.tipp: Powder snow lies on snowy slopes. Very seasonal!
questbuch.ankommen.pulverschnee.tun: Walk on powder snow in leather boots without sinking.
questbuch.ankommen.regeln.schritt.1: Read the rules once, calmly. They are short.
questbuch.ankommen.regeln.schritt.2: Remember: no building on the spawn island.
questbuch.ankommen.regeln.schritt.3: Ask in chat if anything is unclear.
questbuch.ankommen.regeln.tipp: No building on the spawn island. Apart from that: have fun and merry Christmas!
questbuch.ankommen.regeln.tun: No griefing, no stealing, no X-ray. PvP only if both players agree.
questbuch.ankommen.ruestung.schritt.1: Smelt iron ingots in the furnace. Make enough of them.
questbuch.ankommen.ruestung.schritt.2: Lay out 4 iron ingots as boots: the cheapest piece.
questbuch.ankommen.ruestung.schritt.3: Or use 8 ingots for the chestplate, which protects most.
questbuch.ankommen.ruestung.schritt.4: Put it on by dragging it into an armor slot in your inventory.
questbuch.ankommen.ruestung.tipp: The chestplate protects best, the boots are the cheapest.
questbuch.ankommen.ruestung.tun: Craft a piece of iron armor.
questbuch.ankommen.schild.schritt.1: Lay out 6 planks and 1 iron ingot as a shield.
questbuch.ankommen.schild.schritt.2: Hold the shield in your off hand and keep right-click pressed.
questbuch.ankommen.schild.schritt.3: Find a skeleton that shoots at you and block an arrow.
questbuch.ankommen.schild.tipp: Hold right-click to raise it. Skeletons make great sparring partners.
questbuch.ankommen.schild.tun: Block a projectile with a shield.
questbuch.ankommen.spende.brauchst: Something that is on the current wish list
questbuch.ankommen.spende.schritt.1: Go to the Ender Chest in the middle of Spark Island and open it.
questbuch.ankommen.spende.schritt.2: Click the Christmas Island entry (“Weihnachtsinsel”). It shows what the island wishes for right now.
questbuch.ankommen.spende.schritt.3: Put wished-for items in the window and close it. Everything else comes back to you.
questbuch.ankommen.spende.schritt.4: When a stage is full, everyone gets 3 potions. If your inventory was full, right-click the Christmas Island entry to collect them.
questbuch.ankommen.spende.tipp: Every full stage makes the island grow to the north and gives every player 3 potions. Giving really pays off here.
questbuch.ankommen.spende.titel: First Gift for the Christmas Island
questbuch.ankommen.spende.tun: Open the Ender Chest in the middle of Spark Island, click the Christmas Island entry (“Weihnachtsinsel”) and hand in something from the wish list.
questbuch.ankommen.stein.schritt.1: Craft sticks from planks. Your inventory grid is enough.
questbuch.ankommen.stein.schritt.2: Lay 3 planks and 2 sticks out as a pickaxe at the crafting table.
questbuch.ankommen.stein.schritt.3: Mine a stone block: you get cobblestone.
questbuch.ankommen.stein.tipp: Stone is usually right below the dirt.
questbuch.ankommen.stein.tun: Craft a wooden pickaxe and mine some stone.
questbuch.ankommen.voice_chat.schritt.1: Just talk, voice chat picks you up automatically.
questbuch.ankommen.voice_chat.schritt.2: Press V to open the voice chat menu.
questbuch.ankommen.voice_chat.schritt.3: Ä mutes and unmutes your mic.
questbuch.ankommen.voice_chat.schritt.4: Create a group there for you and your friends.
questbuch.ankommen.voice_chat.tipp: Create groups from the menu (V). Voice chat needs the modpack.
questbuch.ankommen.voice_chat.tun: Voice chat picks you up as soon as you speak. V opens the menu, Ä mutes your mic.
questbuch.ankommen.werkbank.fundort.1: Oaks grow in almost every forest and in plains.
questbuch.ankommen.werkbank.schritt.1: Punch a tree trunk with your bare hand.
questbuch.ankommen.werkbank.schritt.2: Turn it into planks in your inventory.
questbuch.ankommen.werkbank.schritt.3: Put 4 planks in the 2×2 grid: there's your crafting table.
questbuch.ankommen.werkbank.schritt.4: Place it down. It gives you a 3×3 grid.
questbuch.ankommen.werkbank.tipp: The recipe book (green book in your inventory) shows what you can craft.
questbuch.ankommen.werkbank.tun: Punch a tree, turn the logs into planks and craft a crafting table.
questbuch.ankommen.werkzeug.schritt.1: Collect at least 3 cobblestone with the wooden pickaxe.
questbuch.ankommen.werkzeug.schritt.2: Lay out 3 cobblestone and 2 sticks like the wooden pickaxe.
questbuch.ankommen.werkzeug.schritt.3: This one can mine iron ore.
questbuch.ankommen.werkzeug.tipp: This one can mine iron. Wood is so last week.
questbuch.bergbau.armor_poser.schritt.3: Turn head, arms and legs one by one into your pose.
questbuch.bergbau.armor_poser.tipp: Head, arms and legs can be posed one by one. Great for decorating.
questbuch.bergbau.armor_poser.tun: Hold Ctrl and right-click an armor stand to change its pose.
questbuch.bergbau.beschreibung: Dig deeper, gear up. The diamonds are waiting below.
questbuch.bergbau.buecherregal.brauchst: Chiseled bookshelf: 6 planks, 3 wooden slabs. Plus a comparator
questbuch.bergbau.buecherregal.schritt.1: Lay out 6 planks and 3 wooden slabs as a chiseled bookshelf.
questbuch.bergbau.buecherregal.schritt.2: Craft a comparator and place it behind the shelf.
questbuch.bergbau.buecherregal.schritt.3: The comparator must point away from the shelf.
questbuch.bergbau.buecherregal.schritt.4: Put a book in a slot: the signal shows the last used slot.
questbuch.bergbau.buecherregal.tipp: Point the comparator away from the shelf. The signal shows which slot was used last.
questbuch.bergbau.buecherregal.tun: Read a chiseled bookshelf's signal with a comparator.
questbuch.bergbau.diamanten.fundort.1: Diamonds lie deep underground, most common near the bottom.
questbuch.bergbau.diamanten.schritt.1: Take your iron pickaxe and torches down with you.
questbuch.bergbau.diamanten.schritt.2: Press F3 and watch your height (Y), for example -59.
questbuch.bergbau.diamanten.schritt.3: Dig a straight tunnel there and light it up.
questbuch.bergbau.diamanten.schritt.4: Mine diamond ore to get diamonds.
questbuch.bergbau.diamanten.tipp: Most common around Y -59. F3 shows your height.
questbuch.bergbau.diamantruestung.schrit: Collect at least 4 diamonds for one piece of armor.
Lay out 4 diamonds as boots at the crafting table.
Keep 2 diamonds for an enchanting table.
questbuch.bergbau.diamantruestung.tipp: Keep 2 diamonds for an enchanting table.
questbuch.bergbau.diamantruestung.tun: Craft a piece of diamond armor.
questbuch.bergbau.kupferleuchte.brauchst: Copper bulb: 3 copper blocks, 1 blaze rod, 1 redstone. Plus an axe
Ready-made copper bulbs hang in trial chambers.
Collect 3 copper blocks (9 ingots each), 1 blaze rod and 1 redstone.
Craft a copper bulb, or grab a ready-made one from a trial chamber.
Take a copper bulb that has already weathered.
Scrape it with an axe: it glows brighter.
questbuch.bergbau.kupferleuchte.tipp: Blaze rods only come from the Nether, but trial chambers have ready-made bulbs.
questbuch.bergbau.kupferleuchte.tun: Scrape a weathered copper bulb with an axe to make it brighter.
questbuch.bergbau.leuchtschild.brauchst: A sign, a glow ink sac
questbuch.bergbau.leuchtschild.schritt.1: Find a glow squid in dark water, often in caves.
questbuch.bergbau.leuchtschild.schritt.2: Kill it and pick up the glow ink sac.
questbuch.bergbau.leuchtschild.schritt.3: Place a sign and write something on it.
questbuch.bergbau.leuchtschild.schritt.4: Right-click the text with the glow ink sac: it glows.
questbuch.bergbau.leuchtschild.tipp: Glow squids live in dark water, often in caves.
questbuch.bergbau.leuchtschild.tun: Make the text on a sign glow.
questbuch.bergbau.obsidian.schritt.1: Craft a bucket from iron and collect water and lava.
questbuch.bergbau.obsidian.schritt.2: Pour water onto still lava: it turns into obsidian.
questbuch.bergbau.obsidian.schritt.3: Craft a diamond pickaxe: 3 diamonds and 2 sticks.
questbuch.bergbau.obsidian.schritt.4: Mine the obsidian with it. It takes a while.
questbuch.bergbau.obsidian.tipp: Pour water onto still lava. Only diamond or netherite can mine it.
questbuch.bergbau.truhe.schritt.1: Lay out 8 planks in a ring around an empty slot.
questbuch.bergbau.truhe.schritt.2: Place the chest on the ground.
questbuch.bergbau.truhe.schritt.3: Place a second next to it to make a large chest.
questbuch.bergbau.truhe.tipp: Two chests side by side make a big one. With the resource pack they look like presents!
questbuch.bergbau.verzaubern.brauchst: Enchanting table: 1 book, 2 diamonds, 4 obsidian. Plus lapis lazuli and XP
questbuch.bergbau.verzaubern.fundort.1: Lapis lazuli is most common at heights of about -32 to 32.
questbuch.bergbau.verzaubern.schritt.1: Craft a book from 3 paper and 1 leather.
questbuch.bergbau.verzaubern.schritt.2: Lay out the book, 2 diamonds and 4 obsidian as an enchanting table.
questbuch.bergbau.verzaubern.schritt.3: Place it and put lapis lazuli and a tool inside.
questbuch.bergbau.verzaubern.schritt.4: Pick an enchantment and pay with experience.
questbuch.bergbau.verzaubern.schritt.5: With 15 bookshelves nearby you unlock the best enchantments.
questbuch.bergbau.verzaubern.tipp: 15 bookshelves one block away unlock the best enchantments.
questbuch.bergbau.verzaubern.tun: Enchant an item at an enchanting table.
questbuch.bergbau.werker.brauchst: Crafter: 5 iron ingots, 1 crafting table, 1 dropper, 2 redstone
questbuch.bergbau.werker.schritt.1: Craft a dropper and a crafting table to go with it.
questbuch.bergbau.werker.schritt.2: Lay out 5 iron ingots, crafting table, dropper and 2 redstone as a crafter.
questbuch.bergbau.werker.schritt.3: Place the crafter and fill it with the ingredients for another.
questbuch.bergbau.werker.schritt.4: Give it a redstone pulse, e.g. with a button. Stay nearby.
questbuch.bergbau.werker.tipp: Put the ingredients in and give it a redstone pulse, e.g. with a button.
questbuch.bergbau.werker.tun: Be near a crafter while it crafts a crafter.
questbuch.dorf.blitzableiter.brauchst: Lightning rod: 3 copper ingots. Plus a thunderstorm
questbuch.dorf.blitzableiter.schritt.1: Craft a lightning rod from 3 copper ingots stacked.
questbuch.dorf.blitzableiter.schritt.2: Put it on a stone roof or stone tower next to the villager.
questbuch.dorf.blitzableiter.schritt.3: Keep a villager close, within 30 blocks.
questbuch.dorf.blitzableiter.schritt.4: Wait for a thunderstorm: lightning hits the rod and nothing burns.
questbuch.dorf.blitzableiter.tipp: Put it on stone, not on a wooden roof.
questbuch.dorf.blitzableiter.tun: Protect a villager with a lightning rod without starting a fire.
questbuch.dorf.dorf_finden.fundort.1: Villages appear in plains, meadows, deserts, savannas, taigas and snowy plains.
questbuch.dorf.dorf_finden.schritt.1: Head to plains, meadows, deserts, savannas, taigas or snowy plains.
questbuch.dorf.dorf_finden.schritt.2: Look out for houses, paths and a bell.
questbuch.dorf.dorf_finden.schritt.3: Stay close until you see a villager: neighbourhood!
questbuch.dorf.dorf_finden.tipp: Villages appear in plains, deserts, savannas, taigas and snowy tundras.
questbuch.dorf.dorfheld.schritt.1: Gear up: good armor, a weapon, food, ideally with friends.
questbuch.dorf.dorfheld.schritt.2: Take the ominous bottle to a village and drink it there.
questbuch.dorf.dorfheld.schritt.3: Defend the villagers against every wave of the raid.
questbuch.dorf.dorfheld.schritt.4: Survive all the waves and you become Hero of the Village. Discounts included!
questbuch.dorf.dorfheld.tipp: Drink the bottle in the village and survive every wave. Discounts and gifts follow.
questbuch.dorf.dorfheld.tun: Successfully defend a village from a raid.
questbuch.dorf.golem.schritt.1: Craft 4 iron blocks, each from 9 iron ingots.
questbuch.dorf.golem.schritt.2: Carve a pumpkin with shears to get a carved pumpkin.
questbuch.dorf.golem.schritt.3: Place 3 iron blocks in a row and 1 above the middle, a T shape.
questbuch.dorf.golem.schritt.4: Put the pumpkin on top last: the golem awakens.
questbuch.dorf.golem.tipp: Iron blocks in a T shape, pumpkin on top last.
questbuch.dorf.handel.brauchst: Emeralds or the goods they want
questbuch.dorf.handel.schritt.1: Collect a few emeralds or the goods the trader wants.
questbuch.dorf.handel.schritt.2: Find a villager with a job. Jobless ones don't trade.
questbuch.dorf.handel.schritt.3: No job yet? Place a workstation, e.g. a composter for a farmer.
questbuch.dorf.handel.schritt.4: Right-click the villager, pick an offer and trade.
questbuch.dorf.handel.tipp: Jobless villagers claim a workstation, e.g. a composter makes them a farmer.
questbuch.dorf.hauptmann.fundort.1: Pillager outposts stand in deserts, plains, savannas, snowy plains, taigas, mountains and groves.
questbuch.dorf.hauptmann.schritt.1: Find a pillager outpost, the dark wooden tower.
questbuch.dorf.hauptmann.schritt.2: Look for the pillager with a banner on their head: that's the captain.
questbuch.dorf.hauptmann.schritt.3: Defeat them, ideally with armor and some distance.
questbuch.dorf.hauptmann.schritt.4: Pick up the ominous bottle they drop.
questbuch.dorf.hauptmann.tipp: Spot them by their banner. They drop an ominous bottle: drinking it starts a raid.
questbuch.dorf.pluenderer.brauchst: Crossbow: 3 sticks, 2 string, 1 iron ingot, 1 tripwire hook
questbuch.dorf.pluenderer.schritt.1: Craft a crossbow: 3 sticks, 2 string, 1 iron ingot, 1 tripwire hook.
questbuch.dorf.pluenderer.schritt.2: Pack arrows and load the crossbow with right-click.
questbuch.dorf.pluenderer.schritt.3: Find a pillager, e.g. at the dark wooden tower of an outpost.
questbuch.dorf.pluenderer.schritt.4: Shoot him down with the crossbow.
questbuch.dorf.pluenderer.tipp: Pillager outposts are the dark wooden towers.
questbuch.dorf.pluenderer.tun: Kill a pillager with a crossbow.
questbuch.dorf.rabatt.schritt.1: Open the trading window, close it and open it again.
questbuch.dorf.rabatt.schritt.2: Now the discount shows in the prices. Cured zombie villagers add even more.
questbuch.dorf.rabatt.tipp: Cured zombie villagers give big extra discounts.
questbuch.dorf.rabatt.tun: Trading is discounted on this server. The discount shows once you close the trading window and open it again.
questbuch.dorf.sternhaendler.brauchst: Lots of blocks, a villager and patience
questbuch.dorf.sternhaendler.schritt.1: Bring plenty of blocks, e.g. cobblestone.
questbuch.dorf.sternhaendler.schritt.2: Build a water elevator or use a minecart: that's how the villager gets up.
questbuch.dorf.sternhaendler.schritt.3: Build a platform with a rim up there so he can't fall.
questbuch.dorf.sternhaendler.schritt.4: Trade with him from height Y 319 upwards.
questbuch.dorf.sternhaendler.tipp: A water elevator or minecart gets them up there. Don't push them off!
questbuch.dorf.sternhaendler.tun: Trade with a villager at the build limit.
questbuch.dorf.zombiearzt.brauchst: Splash potion of Weakness, golden apple
questbuch.dorf.zombiearzt.schritt.1: Get a splash potion of Weakness.
questbuch.dorf.zombiearzt.schritt.2: Craft a golden apple from 8 gold ingots and 1 apple.
questbuch.dorf.zombiearzt.schritt.3: Get a zombie villager into the shade or a room.
questbuch.dorf.zombiearzt.schritt.4: Throw the potion at him, then give him the apple with right-click.
questbuch.dorf.zombiearzt.schritt.5: Wait until he turns back. Don't forget the sun protection!
questbuch.dorf.zombiearzt.tipp: Throw the potion first, then feed the apple. Keep them in the shade or they burn.
questbuch.end.alle_effekte.schritt.1: Plan ahead: you need all 34 status effects at once, even rare ones.
questbuch.end.alle_effekte.schritt.2: Gather potions, a beacon and oddballs like Infested or Weaving.
questbuch.end.alle_effekte.schritt.3: Get friends to help: it is nearly impossible alone.
questbuch.end.alle_effekte.schritt.4: Drink milk buckets afterwards to clear the effects again.
questbuch.end.alle_effekte.tipp: The hardest quest of all. Needs planning, friends and lots of milk afterwards.
questbuch.end.alle_effekte.tun: Have every status effect at once.
questbuch.end.andenken.tipp: The trophy for dragon slayers. Merry Christmas!
questbuch.end.andenken.tun: Finish every ★ quest in this chapter.
questbuch.end.besatz_alle.fundort.1: The Spire template is in End city chests.
questbuch.end.besatz_alle.fundort.2: Silence and Ward are in ancient cities.
questbuch.end.besatz_alle.schritt.1: Collect all 8 templates, from Spire to Wayfinder.
questbuch.end.besatz_alle.schritt.2: Spire: End city chests. Silence and Ward: ancient cities.
questbuch.end.besatz_alle.schritt.3: Snout: bastions. Rib: Nether fortresses. Vex: woodland mansions.
questbuch.end.besatz_alle.schritt.4: Tide: Elder Guardian. Wayfinder: ruins in taiga and jungle.
questbuch.end.besatz_alle.schritt.5: Apply each template once to armor at a smithing table.
questbuch.end.besatz_alle.tipp: Spire is in End cities, Silence in ancient cities, Tide drops from elder guardians.
questbuch.end.besatz_alle.tun: Use each of these smithing templates once: Spire, Snout, Rib, Ward, Silence, Vex, Tide, Wayfinder.
questbuch.end.beschreibung: The End is open! We'll take on the dragon together.
questbuch.end.drache_fernrohr.schritt.1: Craft a spyglass from an amethyst shard and 2 copper ingots.
questbuch.end.drache_fernrohr.schritt.2: Enter the End and look out for the Ender Dragon.
questbuch.end.drache_fernrohr.schritt.3: Look at the dragon through the spyglass, ideally before it notices you!
questbuch.end.drache_fernrohr.tun: Look at the Ender Dragon through a spyglass.
questbuch.end.drache_zurueck.schritt.1: Agree on the date in chat before you respawn the dragon.
questbuch.end.drache_zurueck.schritt.2: Craft an End crystal: 7 glass, an eye of ender and a ghast tear.
questbuch.end.drache_zurueck.schritt.3: Repeat until you have 4 End crystals.
questbuch.end.drache_zurueck.schritt.4: Place one crystal on each side of the exit portal.
questbuch.end.drache_zurueck.tipp: One crystal on each side of the exit portal. Please check in chat first!
questbuch.end.drache.fundort.1: The dragon lives on the main island in the End.
questbuch.end.drache.schritt.1: Agree on the date: we beat the dragon together.
questbuch.end.drache.schritt.2: Shoot the End crystals on the obsidian pillars with arrows.
questbuch.end.drache.schritt.3: Attack the dragon when it swoops low.
questbuch.end.drache.schritt.4: Bring its health bar to zero: done!
questbuch.end.drache.tipp: Destroy the crystals on the pillars first, or it keeps healing.
questbuch.end.drachenatem.schritt.1: Craft glass bottles from 3 glass blocks.
questbuch.end.drachenatem.schritt.2: Keep a bottle in hand during the fight.
questbuch.end.drachenatem.schritt.3: Scoop the dragon's purple cloud with the bottle.
questbuch.end.drachenatem.tipp: Hold the bottle into the purple cloud the dragon leaves behind.
questbuch.end.drachenatem.tun: Collect dragon's breath in a glass bottle.
questbuch.end.drachenei.schritt.1: Beat the Ender Dragon: afterwards the dragon egg sits on the exit portal.
questbuch.end.drachenei.schritt.2: Don't click it or it teleports away!
questbuch.end.drachenei.schritt.3: Craft a piston from planks, cobblestone, iron and redstone.
questbuch.end.drachenei.schritt.4: Push the egg down with the piston and pick it up.
questbuch.end.drachenei.tipp: Don't click it or it teleports! Push it with a piston and pick it up.
questbuch.end.drachenkampf.schritt.1: Check chat and Discord for the date of the dragon fight.
questbuch.end.drachenkampf.schritt.2: Pack a bow, plenty of arrows, blocks, a water bucket and food.
questbuch.end.drachenkampf.schritt.3: Be on time in the End: we take down the dragon together.
questbuch.end.drachenkampf.tipp: Bring a bow, lots of arrows, blocks, a water bucket and food.
questbuch.end.drachenkampf.tun: We fight the dragon together. Check chat and Discord for the date.
questbuch.end.elytra.fundort.1: The End ship stands next to some End cities, not all.
questbuch.end.elytra.schritt.1: Look for an End city with an End ship next to it.
questbuch.end.elytra.schritt.2: Climb into the ship and look around.
questbuch.end.elytra.schritt.3: Take the elytra from the item frame.
questbuch.end.elytra.schritt.4: Craft firework rockets for a boost.
questbuch.end.elytra.tipp: It hangs in the End ship next to some End cities. Rockets give a boost.
questbuch.end.end.brauchst: Up to 12 eyes of ender for the frame
questbuch.end.end.schritt.1: Dig through the stronghold to the room with the End portal frames.
questbuch.end.end.schritt.2: Put an eye of ender in every empty frame: up to 12 are needed.
questbuch.end.end.schritt.3: Once all are filled, the End portal opens.
questbuch.end.end.schritt.4: Bring blocks and a bow before you jump in.
questbuch.end.end.schritt.5: Jump into the portal: you land in the End.
questbuch.end.end.tipp: The portal is deep inside the stronghold. Bring blocks and a bow.
questbuch.end.end.tun: Enter the End through the End portal.
questbuch.end.enderauge.brauchst: Eye of ender: ender pearl + blaze powder
questbuch.end.enderauge.fundort.1: Strongholds lie beneath the Overworld, in almost any biome.
questbuch.end.enderauge.schritt.1: Hunt Endermen and collect their ender pearls.
questbuch.end.enderauge.schritt.2: Turn blaze rods into blaze powder.
questbuch.end.enderauge.schritt.3: Combine an ender pearl and blaze powder into an eye of ender.
questbuch.end.enderauge.schritt.4: Throw the eye of ender: it flies toward the stronghold. Follow it!
questbuch.end.enderauge.schritt.5: Repeat until the eye sinks down: the stronghold is below.
questbuch.end.enderauge.tipp: Throw it up and follow it. Some break, so bring plenty.
questbuch.end.enderauge.tun: Follow an eye of ender to a stronghold.
questbuch.end.endsiedlung.fundort.1: End cities only generate on the outer islands.
questbuch.end.endsiedlung.schritt.1: Travel through an End gateway to the outer islands.
questbuch.end.endsiedlung.schritt.2: Look for tall purple towers in the End Highlands and Midlands.
questbuch.end.endsiedlung.schritt.3: Step inside, but beware of shulkers!
questbuch.end.endsiedlung.tipp: Tall purple towers on the outer islands. Shulkers fire bullets that make you levitate.
questbuch.end.kuerbis.schritt.1: Find a pumpkin and take it with you.
questbuch.end.kuerbis.schritt.3: Use the shears on the pumpkin to get a carved pumpkin.
questbuch.end.kuerbis.schritt.4: Put it in your helmet slot. Looks great on you!
questbuch.end.kuerbis.tipp: Endermen won't get angry when you look at them. Suits you!
questbuch.end.schweben.schritt.1: Find an End city and get the attention of some shulkers.
questbuch.end.schweben.schritt.2: Let their bullets hit you: you start floating up.
questbuch.end.schweben.schritt.3: Get hit again and again until you are 50 blocks up.
questbuch.end.schweben.schritt.4: Have the water bucket ready for landing.
questbuch.end.schweben.tipp: Get hit several times. For the landing: water bucket!
questbuch.end.schweben.tun: Levitate 50 blocks up from shulker bullets.
questbuch.end.transitportal.schritt.1: Beat the dragon: small portals then appear at the island's edge.
questbuch.end.transitportal.schritt.2: Take an ender pearl and stand next to a gateway.
questbuch.end.transitportal.schritt.3: Throw the pearl into the gateway and travel to the outer islands.
questbuch.end.transitportal.tipp: After the fight small portals appear at the edge. Throw a pearl into one.
questbuch.end.transitportal.tun: Leave the main island through an End gateway.
questbuch.entdecken.besatz.brauchst: Smithing table, smithing template, armor, a material like gold, copper or amethyst
questbuch.entdecken.besatz.schritt.1: Craft a smithing table from 2 iron ingots and 4 planks.
questbuch.entdecken.besatz.schritt.2: Look in structure chests for a smithing template.
questbuch.entdecken.besatz.schritt.3: At the smithing table, add template, armor and a material like gold or copper.
questbuch.entdecken.besatz.schritt.4: Take out the trimmed piece: stylish!
questbuch.entdecken.besatz.tipp: Templates are in structure chests. 7 diamonds let you copy one.
questbuch.entdecken.besatz.tun: Add a trim to armor at a smithing table.
questbuch.entdecken.beschreibung: Biomes, trial chambers, ruins and old sherds. It's a big world, off you go!
questbuch.entdecken.biome.schritt.1: Pack food, a bed and a map and set off.
questbuch.entdecken.biome.schritt.2: Open the map with M and see which corners are still empty.
questbuch.entdecken.biome.schritt.3: Visit one biome after another, 56 in total.
questbuch.entdecken.biome.schritt.4: Don't forget caves and oceans, they count too.
questbuch.entdecken.biome.tipp: The map (M) shows where you've been. A project for several weeks.
questbuch.entdecken.fernrohr.schritt.1: Smelt copper ore in a furnace into copper ingots.
questbuch.entdecken.fernrohr.schritt.2: Find a geode and mine an amethyst shard.
questbuch.entdecken.fernrohr.schritt.3: Shard on top, 2 copper ingots below: your spyglass.
questbuch.entdecken.fernrohr.tipp: Amethyst grows in geodes underground. Purple and hard to miss.
questbuch.entdecken.knarzherz.brauchst: Creaking heart (needs Silk Touch), 2 pale oak logs
questbuch.entdecken.knarzherz.fundort.1: Creaking hearts grow in pale oaks in the pale garden.
questbuch.entdecken.knarzherz.schritt.1: Enchant a pickaxe with Silk Touch.
questbuch.entdecken.knarzherz.schritt.2: Find the pale garden and go by day only, the creaking wakes at night.
questbuch.entdecken.knarzherz.schritt.3: Mine a creaking heart with the pickaxe and take 2 pale oak logs.
questbuch.entdecken.knarzherz.schritt.4: Place two logs with a gap between them and the heart in the middle.
questbuch.entdecken.knarzherz.tipp: Creaking hearts are in the pale garden. The creaking wakes at night, so go by day.
questbuch.entdecken.knarzherz.tun: Place a creaking heart the right way round between two pale oak logs.
questbuch.entdecken.krug.schritt.1: Collect 4 pottery sherds, different ones are fine.
questbuch.entdecken.krug.schritt.2: Place them on the four sides in the crafting table.
questbuch.entdecken.krug.schritt.3: There's your decorated pot. The sherds decide the pictures.
questbuch.entdecken.krug.tipp: The sherds decide the pictures on each side.
questbuch.entdecken.krug.tun: Craft a decorated pot from 4 pottery sherds.
questbuch.entdecken.leitstein.brauchst: Lodestone: 8 chiseled stone bricks, 1 iron ingot. Plus a compass
questbuch.entdecken.leitstein.schritt.1: Craft 8 chiseled stone bricks around an iron ingot: a lodestone.
questbuch.entdecken.leitstein.schritt.2: Craft a compass from 4 iron ingots and redstone.
questbuch.entdecken.leitstein.schritt.3: Place the lodestone and right-click it with the compass.
questbuch.entdecken.leitstein.schritt.4: The compass now always points to the lodestone, your way home.
questbuch.entdecken.leitstein.tipp: The compass then always points to the lodestone. Your way home.
questbuch.entdecken.leitstein.tun: Use a compass on a lodestone.
questbuch.entdecken.musik.brauchst: Jukebox: 8 planks, 1 diamond. Plus a music disc
questbuch.entdecken.musik.fundort.1: The jukebox has to play in a meadow.
questbuch.entdecken.musik.schritt.1: Craft a jukebox from 8 planks and 1 diamond.
questbuch.entdecken.musik.schritt.2: Get a music disc from a chest or a creeper-skeleton accident.
questbuch.entdecken.musik.schritt.3: Find a meadow biome with its flowery grass.
questbuch.entdecken.musik.schritt.4: Place the jukebox there and put in the disc.
questbuch.entdecken.musik.tipp: Discs are found in chests or drop when a skeleton shoots a creeper.
questbuch.entdecken.musik.tun: Play music in a meadow with a jukebox.
Trial chambers lie deep underground, in many biomes.
Head down with torches, food and armor.
Look for tuff and copper blocks, that's how you spot a trial chamber.
The map doesn't show them, so you have to track one down yourself.
questbuch.entdecken.pruefkammer.tipp: Trial chambers are underground, built from tuff and copper. The map hides them on purpose.
questbuch.entdecken.scherbe.fundort.1: Suspicious sand hides in desert temples and warm ocean ruins.
questbuch.entdecken.scherbe.fundort.2: Suspicious gravel hides in trail ruins and cold ocean ruins.
questbuch.entdecken.scherbe.schritt.1: Craft a brush from a feather, copper ingot and stick.
questbuch.entdecken.scherbe.schritt.2: Find a desert pyramid, trail ruins or ocean ruins.
questbuch.entdecken.scherbe.schritt.3: Hold right-click on suspicious sand or gravel to brush it.
questbuch.entdecken.scherbe.schritt.4: With luck, a pottery sherd turns up.
questbuch.entdecken.scherbe.tipp: Suspicious sand hides in desert temples and warm ocean ruins, suspicious gravel in trail ruins and cold ocean ruins.
questbuch.entdecken.scherbe.tun: Brush suspicious sand or gravel to find a pottery sherd.
questbuch.entdecken.tresor_unheil.schrit: Get an ominous bottle: from a trial chamber vault or from a raid captain.
Drink it before the trial chamber to get the Bad Omen effect.
Enter the chamber: spawners get tougher and drop ominous keys.
Open an ominous vault with the ominous key.
questbuch.entdecken.tresor_unheil.tipp: Drink the bottle before entering: spawners get tougher and drop ominous keys.
questbuch.entdecken.tresor_unheil.tun: Unlock an ominous vault with an ominous trial key.
questbuch.entdecken.tresor.schritt.1: Enter a trial chamber and find a trial spawner.
questbuch.entdecken.tresor.schritt.2: Defeat the mobs it spawns: it then drops a trial key.
questbuch.entdecken.tresor.schritt.3: Hold the key and right-click a vault.
questbuch.entdecken.tresor.schritt.4: It ejects loot. Each vault opens once per player.
questbuch.entdecken.tresor.tipp: Trial spawners drop the keys. Each vault opens only once per player.
questbuch.entdecken.tresor.tun: Unlock a vault with a trial key.
questbuch.kampf.alle_monster.schritt.1: Gear up with a sword, armor and a bow.
questbuch.kampf.alle_monster.schritt.2: Kill a zombie, skeleton, spider, creeper and witch, those come quickly.
questbuch.kampf.alle_monster.schritt.3: Hunt the rarer ones: breeze, creaking, phantom and drowned.
questbuch.kampf.alle_monster.schritt.4: Nether and End mobs come next, the list has 41 mobs. Be patient!
questbuch.kampf.alle_monster.tipp: Nether and End mobs count too, so this takes until Christmas and beyond.
questbuch.kampf.alle_monster.tun: Kill every hostile mob at least once.
questbuch.kampf.armbrust_fuenf.schritt.1: Enchant a crossbow with Piercing, ideally level IV.
questbuch.kampf.armbrust_fuenf.schritt.2: Lure five different mobs into a straight line, for example a corridor.
questbuch.kampf.armbrust_fuenf.schritt.3: Load the crossbow and shoot along the whole line.
questbuch.kampf.armbrust_fuenf.schritt.4: All five must die from the same shot and be different kinds.
questbuch.kampf.armbrust_fuenf.tipp: Line the mobs up. Piercing IV helps a lot.
questbuch.kampf.armbrust_fuenf.tun: Kill 5 different mobs with one crossbow shot.
questbuch.kampf.armbrust.brauchst: Crossbow: 3 sticks, 2 string, 1 iron ingot, 1 tripwire hook
questbuch.kampf.armbrust.schritt.1: Craft a tripwire hook from an iron ingot, a stick and a plank.
questbuch.kampf.armbrust.schritt.2: Put 3 sticks, 2 string, 1 iron ingot and the hook in the crafting table.
questbuch.kampf.armbrust.schritt.3: Hold right-click until the crossbow is loaded, then release.
questbuch.kampf.armbrust.schritt.4: Click again and the arrow flies.
questbuch.kampf.armbrust.tipp: Hold right-click to load, then click again.
questbuch.kampf.beschreibung: Bow, crossbow, trident, spear and mace. For those who like a bit of action.
questbuch.kampf.blitz.schritt.2: Wait for a thunderstorm, only then the lightning strikes.
questbuch.kampf.blitz.schritt.3: Find a villager outdoors and throw the trident at him.
questbuch.kampf.blitz.schritt.4: Lightning hits him and he turns into a witch. Sorry, little guy.
questbuch.kampf.blitz.tipp: The villager turns into a witch. Sorry, little guy.
questbuch.kampf.dreizack.schritt.1: Look for drowned in oceans and rivers, also on land at night.
questbuch.kampf.dreizack.schritt.2: Some carry a trident. Kill one and pick it up.
questbuch.kampf.dreizack.schritt.3: Hold right-click and release to throw the trident.
questbuch.kampf.dreizack.tipp: Only some drowned carry one. Loyalty brings it back.
questbuch.kampf.gegenwind.schritt.1: Find a breeze, for example in a trial chamber.
questbuch.kampf.gegenwind.schritt.2: Let it shoot at you and wait for its wind charge.
questbuch.kampf.gegenwind.schritt.3: Hit the wind charge back at the breeze just before it reaches you.
questbuch.kampf.gegenwind.tipp: Hit the breeze's wind charge back right before it reaches you.
questbuch.kampf.gegenwind.tun: Kill a breeze with its own wind charge.
questbuch.kampf.phantome.schritt.2: Skip sleeping for 3 nights and phantoms will show up.
questbuch.kampf.phantome.schritt.3: Wait until two phantoms line up while diving at you.
questbuch.kampf.phantome.schritt.4: Shoot a single arrow through both.
questbuch.kampf.phantome.tipp: Phantoms show up if you skip sleep for 3 nights. This time you want that!
questbuch.kampf.phantome.tun: Kill 2 phantoms with one piercing arrow.
questbuch.kampf.pvp.schritt.1: Want to challenge someone? Ask in chat first.
questbuch.kampf.pvp.schritt.2: Only fight if both say yes. A virtual handshake afterwards is nice.
questbuch.kampf.pvp.tipp: Ask in chat before you duel.
questbuch.kampf.pvp.tun: PvP only if both players agree.
questbuch.kampf.scharfschuetze.schritt.1: Take a bow and plenty of arrows, ideally with Power.
questbuch.kampf.scharfschuetze.schritt.2: Find a skeleton out in the open, best at night or in a cave.
questbuch.kampf.scharfschuetze.schritt.3: Back off at least 50 blocks and aim above the target.
questbuch.kampf.scharfschuetze.schritt.4: Finish it with an arrow. Only arrows count, no sword!
questbuch.kampf.scharfschuetze.tipp: Works best from a hill over flat land.
questbuch.kampf.scharfschuetze.tun: Kill a skeleton from at least 50 blocks away.
questbuch.kampf.schleichen.fundort.1: You find sculk sensors in the Deep Dark.
questbuch.kampf.schleichen.schritt.1: Go to the Deep Dark and find a sculk sensor.
questbuch.kampf.schleichen.schritt.3: Sneak past the sensor or warden without it noticing.
questbuch.kampf.schleichen.tipp: Hold Shift. The warden hears everything, so keep it quiet.
questbuch.kampf.schleichen.tun: Sneak past a sculk sensor or warden without being noticed.
questbuch.kampf.sculk.fundort.1: Ancient cities and sculk are found in the Deep Dark.
questbuch.kampf.sculk.schritt.1: Dig down to the Deep Dark at the very bottom of the world. Bring torches.
questbuch.kampf.sculk.schritt.2: Find a sculk catalyst, it grows in the Deep Dark.
questbuch.kampf.sculk.schritt.3: Kill a mob close to it, for example one you brought along.
questbuch.kampf.sculk.tipp: Catalysts are found in the Deep Dark, at the very bottom of the world.
questbuch.kampf.sculk.tun: Kill a mob near a sculk catalyst.
questbuch.kampf.speer.brauchst: Spear: 1 iron (or wood, stone, copper, gold, diamond), 2 sticks
questbuch.kampf.speer.schritt.1: Put 1 iron and 2 sticks diagonally in the crafting table: a spear.
questbuch.kampf.speer.schritt.2: Find a group of mobs, for example a pen full of animals.
questbuch.kampf.speer.schritt.3: Take a run-up and charge through the group with the spear.
questbuch.kampf.speer.schritt.4: Five hits in a single charge and you're done.
questbuch.kampf.speer.tipp: Take a run-up and charge straight through a group.
questbuch.kampf.speer.tun: Hit 5 mobs in a single charge with a spear.
questbuch.kampf.streitkolben.fundort.1: Heavy cores come from ominous vaults in trial chambers.
questbuch.kampf.streitkolben.schritt.1: Get a heavy core from an ominous vault.
questbuch.kampf.streitkolben.schritt.2: Stack a heavy core on a breeze rod: a mace.
questbuch.kampf.streitkolben.schritt.3: Launch yourself way up with a wind charge.
questbuch.kampf.streitkolben.schritt.4: Plunge onto a mob: the longer the fall, the harder the hit.
questbuch.kampf.streitkolben.tipp: The further you fall, the harder you hit. Wind charges get you up high.
questbuch.kampf.streitkolben.tun: Deal 50 hearts of damage in one hit with a mace.
questbuch.kampf.totem.brauchst: Totem (from evokers in mansions and raids)
questbuch.kampf.totem.fundort.1: Woodland mansions stand in dark forests and in the pale garden.
questbuch.kampf.totem.schritt.1: Find a woodland mansion or trigger a raid.
questbuch.kampf.totem.schritt.2: Kill an evoker, it drops a Totem of Undying.
questbuch.kampf.totem.schritt.3: Hold the totem in your main or off hand.
questbuch.kampf.totem.schritt.4: When you would die, it saves you and is used up.
questbuch.kampf.totem.tipp: Hold it in your main or off hand when things get tight.
questbuch.kampf.totem.tun: Cheat death with a Totem of Undying.
questbuch.kampf.windkugel.brauchst: Wind charges (from breeze rods, dropped by breezes in trial chambers)
questbuch.kampf.windkugel.schritt.1: Get breeze rods from breezes in a trial chamber.
questbuch.kampf.windkugel.schritt.2: Put a breeze rod in the crafting grid: 4 wind charges.
questbuch.kampf.windkugel.schritt.3: Throw a wind charge straight down and jump at the same time.
questbuch.kampf.windkugel.schritt.4: You soar at least 8 blocks up. Who needs rockets?
questbuch.kampf.windkugel.tipp: Throw it straight down and jump at the same time.
questbuch.kampf.windkugel.tun: Launch yourself 8 blocks up with a wind charge.
questbuch.kampf.zielblock.brauchst: Target: 4 redstone, 1 hay bale. Plus a bow
questbuch.kampf.zielblock.schritt.1: Craft a hay bale from 9 wheat.
questbuch.kampf.zielblock.schritt.2: Put the hay bale in the middle and 4 redstone around it: target block!
questbuch.kampf.zielblock.schritt.3: Place the target block and walk at least 30 blocks away.
questbuch.kampf.zielblock.schritt.4: Draw the bow fully, aim a bit high and hit the exact center.
questbuch.kampf.zielblock.tipp: Aim a little high, arrows drop over distance.
questbuch.kampf.zielblock.tun: Hit the bullseye of a target block from at least 30 blocks away.
questbuch.landwirtschaft.beschreibung: Sow, harvest, relocate some bees. Building is easier on a full stomach.
Enchant a pickaxe or axe with Silk Touch.
Wait for night or rain so all the bees are at home.
Check that 3 bees are inside the nest.
Mine the nest with the Silk Touch tool and move it.
questbuch.landwirtschaft.bienen.tipp: At night or in the rain all bees are at home.
questbuch.landwirtschaft.bienen.tun: Move a bee nest with 3 bees inside using Silk Touch.
questbuch.landwirtschaft.ernaehrung.schr: Eat every kind of food you can find. Really every one.
Poisonous potatoes, spider eyes and rotten flesh count too.
Drink a bucket of milk afterwards to cure the poison.
questbuch.landwirtschaft.ernaehrung.tipp: Yes, poisonous potatoes, spider eyes and rotten flesh too. A milk bucket helps afterwards.
questbuch.landwirtschaft.ernaehrung.tun: Eat everything edible. And we mean everything.
questbuch.landwirtschaft.feld.schritt.1: Craft a wooden hoe: 2 planks and 2 sticks.
questbuch.landwirtschaft.feld.schritt.2: Break tall grass until seeds drop.
questbuch.landwirtschaft.feld.schritt.3: Till dirt with the hoe, ideally next to water.
questbuch.landwirtschaft.feld.schritt.4: Plant the seeds: water hydrates 4 blocks in every direction.
questbuch.landwirtschaft.feld.tipp: Seeds drop from tall grass. One water block hydrates 4 blocks in every direction.
questbuch.landwirtschaft.feld.tun: Plant some seeds and watch them grow.
questbuch.landwirtschaft.honig.brauchst: Glass bottle, campfire under the hive
questbuch.landwirtschaft.honig.schritt.1: Find a beehive or bee nest, often near flowers.
questbuch.landwirtschaft.honig.schritt.2: Place a campfire under the hive: the smoke calms the bees.
questbuch.landwirtschaft.honig.schritt.3: Wait until honey drips from the hive.
questbuch.landwirtschaft.honig.schritt.4: Right-click the hive with a glass bottle to collect the honey.
questbuch.landwirtschaft.honig.tipp: The smoke calms the bees. Harvest once honey drips from the hive.
questbuch.landwirtschaft.honig.tun: Collect honey with a glass bottle without angering the bees.
questbuch.landwirtschaft.honigblock.schr: Put the 4 honey bottles in the 2×2 grid as a honey block.
Place it and jump against the side.
Cling to the side and slide slowly down.
questbuch.landwirtschaft.honigblock.tipp: Only works on the side, not on top.
questbuch.landwirtschaft.honigblock.tun: Jump against the side of a honey block and slide down slowly.
questbuch.landwirtschaft.knochenmehl.sch: Put a bone in the grid: you get 3 bone meal.
Right-click plants and they grow instantly.
questbuch.landwirtschaft.knochenmehl.tip: Right-click plants to make them grow instantly.
Suspicious sand lies in warm ocean ruins.
Craft a brush: feather, copper ingot and stick stacked.
Find warm ocean ruins and look for suspicious sand.
Hold right-click on the sand with the brush.
With luck, a sniffer egg appears.
Brush suspicious sand in warm ocean ruins. With luck there's an egg inside.
questbuch.landwirtschaft.schnueffler_jun: Put the sniffer egg on moss to hatch it twice as fast.
Wait for the snifflet to hatch.
The egg hatches twice as fast on moss.
questbuch.landwirtschaft.schnueffler_sam: Raise the snifflet with torchflower seeds.
Wait for the sniffer to grow up and dig up seeds.
Pick up torchflower seeds or pitcher pods.
Plant a seed on farmland or dirt.
Adult sniffers dig up torchflower seeds and pitcher pods.
Plant a seed dug up by a sniffer.
questbuch.landwirtschaft.wachs_ab.schrit: The wax comes off. It works on oxidation too.
questbuch.landwirtschaft.wachs_ab.tipp: Right-click with the axe. Works on oxidation too.
questbuch.landwirtschaft.wachs_ab.tun: Scrape the wax off again with an axe.
questbuch.landwirtschaft.wachs.brauchst: Copper block: 9 copper ingots. Honeycomb: shears on a full hive
questbuch.landwirtschaft.wachs.schritt.1: Get honeycomb: shear a full hive with shears.
questbuch.landwirtschaft.wachs.schritt.2: Lay out 9 copper ingots as a copper block.
questbuch.landwirtschaft.wachs.schritt.3: Put the copper block and honeycomb together in the grid.
questbuch.landwirtschaft.wachs.tun: Wax a copper block with honeycomb.
questbuch.meldung.start: ❄ Your quest book is here! Press L and pick a chapter.
questbuch.nether.alle_traenke.schritt.1: Brew potions for all 17 effects the challenge asks for.
questbuch.nether.alle_traenke.schritt.2: That includes Infested, Oozing, Weaving and Wind Charged.
questbuch.nether.alle_traenke.schritt.3: Extend potions with redstone and drink the long ones first.
questbuch.nether.alle_traenke.schritt.4: Drink them all in turn until every effect is active at once.
questbuch.nether.alle_traenke.tipp: Drink the long ones first and the short ones last. Redstone extends them.
questbuch.nether.alle_traenke.tun: Have every potion effect at once.
questbuch.nether.andenken.tipp: A real Santa hat to wear. Doesn't keep you warm, but looks great.
questbuch.nether.andenken.tun: Finish every ★ quest in this chapter.
questbuch.nether.aufwertung.fundort.1: The netherite upgrade template is in bastion remnant chests.
questbuch.nether.aufwertung.schritt.1: Loot the chests of a bastion remnant.
questbuch.nether.aufwertung.schritt.2: Take the netherite upgrade template that can be in there.
questbuch.nether.aufwertung.schritt.3: To copy: 7 diamonds, netherrack and the template in a crafting table.
questbuch.nether.aufwertung.tipp: It's in bastion chests. 7 diamonds and netherrack let you copy it.
questbuch.nether.ausgetrockneter_ghast.b: Dried ghast: 8 ghast tears, 1 soul sand
questbuch.nether.ausgetrockneter_ghast.s: Collect 8 ghast tears from ghasts in the Nether.
Put them in a crafting table with 1 soul sand in the middle.
Alternatively, barter with piglins and you may get one.
Place it in water: a happy ghast hatches from it.
questbuch.nether.ausgetrockneter_ghast.t: Given water, a happy ghast hatches from it. You can ride it later!
Place a dried ghast in water.
questbuch.nether.bastion_truhe.fundort.1: Bastion chests are in bridges, hoglin stables, treasure rooms and other areas.
questbuch.nether.bastion_truhe.schritt.1: Go into a bastion remnant and find a chest.
questbuch.nether.bastion_truhe.schritt.2: Open it: every piglin nearby gets angry.
questbuch.nether.bastion_truhe.schritt.3: Grab the loot and run before they catch you.
questbuch.nether.bastion_truhe.tipp: That angers every piglin nearby. Be quick!
questbuch.nether.bastion_truhe.tun: Loot a chest in a bastion remnant.
questbuch.nether.bastion.fundort.1: Bastion remnants generate in nether wastes, soul sand valley, crimson forest and warped forest.
questbuch.nether.bastion.schritt.1: Look for huge blackstone buildings in the Nether.
questbuch.nether.bastion.schritt.2: Wear gold, but don't relax: brutes ignore it.
questbuch.nether.bastion.schritt.3: Enter the bastion remnant and stay close to the exit.
questbuch.nether.bastion.tipp: Huge blackstone buildings. Gold won't save you from piglin brutes.
questbuch.nether.beschreibung: The Nether is open! Hot, dangerous and full of treasure.
questbuch.nether.betten.schritt.1: Don't sleep in a bed in the Nether: it explodes.
questbuch.nether.betten.schritt.2: Use a charged respawn anchor as your spawn point instead.
questbuch.nether.betten.tipp: A charged respawn anchor sets your spawn point here instead.
questbuch.nether.betten.tun: Beds explode in the Nether. Seriously.
questbuch.nether.festung.fundort.1: Nether fortresses can generate in any Nether biome.
questbuch.nether.festung.schritt.1: Pack food, blocks and a good sword.
questbuch.nether.festung.schritt.2: Look for dark nether bricks in the Nether: that's a fortress.
questbuch.nether.festung.schritt.3: Step inside once you've found one. Done!
questbuch.nether.festung.tipp: Fortresses are made of dark nether bricks. Bring plenty of food and blocks.
questbuch.nether.froschlichter.schritt.1: Catch three different frog variants and bring them to the Nether.
questbuch.nether.froschlichter.schritt.2: Take them through the portal in a boat.
questbuch.nether.froschlichter.schritt.3: Let them eat small magma cubes: a froglight drops.
questbuch.nether.froschlichter.schritt.4: Collect all three froglights together in your inventory.
questbuch.nether.froschlichter.tipp: Frogs eat small magma cubes. Take them through the portal in a boat, each colour makes a different light.
questbuch.nether.froschlichter.tun: Have all 3 froglights in your inventory.
questbuch.nether.ghast_ausflug.schritt.1: Build a Nether portal right next to a ghast.
questbuch.nether.ghast_ausflug.schritt.2: Lure the ghast through the portal. Bring lots of patience!
questbuch.nether.ghast_ausflug.schritt.3: Defeat it in the Overworld, ideally with a bow.
questbuch.nether.ghast_ausflug.tipp: Build a portal right next to a ghast and lure it in. Bring lots of patience.
questbuch.nether.ghast_ausflug.tun: Bring a ghast to the Overworld alive, then kill it there.
Craft a spyglass: amethyst shard and 2 copper ingots.
Go to the Nether and look for a ghast.
Look at it through the spyglass from a safe distance.
questbuch.nether.ghast_fernrohr.tipp: Big white cubes that cry a lot. Best from a safe distance.
questbuch.nether.ghast_fernrohr.tun: Look at a ghast through a spyglass.
questbuch.nether.ghast_feuerball.schritt: Find a ghast in the Nether, ideally on open ground.
Wait until it fires a fireball at you.
Hit the fireball back right before it reaches you.
The returned fireball finishes off the ghast.
questbuch.nether.ghast_feuerball.tipp: Hit the fireball back right before it reaches you.
questbuch.nether.ghast_feuerball.tun: Kill a ghast with its own fireball.
questbuch.nether.goldig.schritt.1: Smelt gold into ingots; 4 are enough for boots.
questbuch.nether.goldig.schritt.2: Craft golden boots: two rows of two ingots with a gap.
questbuch.nether.goldig.schritt.3: Put them on: piglins won't attack you anymore.
questbuch.nether.goldig.schritt.4: But mining gold or opening their chests still angers them.
questbuch.nether.goldig.tipp: Piglins then leave you alone. Mining gold or opening their chests still makes them angry.
questbuch.nether.goldig.tun: Wear a piece of gold armor.
questbuch.nether.leuchtfeuer_voll.schrit: Collect 164 mineral blocks: iron is the easiest.
Build tier 1 at 3 × 3 (9 blocks), tier 2 at 5 × 5 (25 blocks).
Tier 3 is 7 × 7 (49 blocks), tier 4 is 9 × 9 (81 blocks).
Beacon on top: full power reached!
questbuch.nether.leuchtfeuer_voll.tipp: Iron is the easiest to farm. Team up!
questbuch.nether.leuchtfeuer_voll.tun: Bring a beacon to full power.
questbuch.nether.leuchtfeuer.brauchst: Nether star, 5 glass, 3 obsidian. Plus 9 iron, gold, emerald or diamond blocks
questbuch.nether.leuchtfeuer.schritt.1: Defeat the Wither and take its nether star.
questbuch.nether.leuchtfeuer.schritt.2: Craft a beacon: nether star, 5 glass, 3 obsidian.
questbuch.nether.leuchtfeuer.schritt.3: Build a 3 × 3 pyramid from 9 iron, gold, emerald or diamond blocks.
questbuch.nether.leuchtfeuer.schritt.4: Place the beacon on top and pick an effect.
questbuch.nether.leuchtfeuer.tipp: The smallest pyramid is 3 × 3, the beacon sits on top.
questbuch.nether.lohe.fundort.1: Blazes hover around spawners in Nether fortresses.
questbuch.nether.lohe.schritt.1: Find a spawner in the fortress with blazes floating around it.
questbuch.nether.lohe.schritt.2: Throw snowballs at the blazes: they handle them surprisingly badly.
questbuch.nether.lohe.schritt.3: Defeat a blaze and pick up its blaze rod.
questbuch.nether.lohe.tipp: Blazes float around spawners in fortresses. Snowballs hurt them surprisingly much!
questbuch.nether.netherbiome.schritt.1: Explore the nether wastes around your portal.
questbuch.nether.netherbiome.schritt.2: Find the soul sand valley, crimson forest and warped forest.
questbuch.nether.netherbiome.schritt.3: Last, the basalt deltas: the ground there is very uneven.
questbuch.nether.netherbiome.tipp: Nether wastes, soul sand valley, crimson forest, warped forest and basalt deltas.
questbuch.nether.netherithacke.schritt.1: Craft a diamond hoe: 2 diamonds and 2 sticks.
questbuch.nether.netherithacke.schritt.2: In a smithing table, add template, hoe and netherite ingot.
questbuch.nether.netherithacke.schritt.3: Take out the netherite hoe: completely over the top, just right.
questbuch.nether.netherithacke.tipp: Completely over the top. Just right.
questbuch.nether.netherithacke.tun: Upgrade a diamond hoe to netherite.
questbuch.nether.netheritruestung.brauch: 4 netherite ingots, 4 upgrade templates, diamond armor
questbuch.nether.netheritruestung.schrit: Smelt ancient debris in a furnace into netherite scrap.
4 netherite scrap and 4 gold ingots make one netherite ingot.
Put diamond armor, upgrade template and ingot in a smithing table.
Repeat for helmet, leggings and boots: 4 pieces.
questbuch.nether.netheritruestung.tipp: Netherite ingot = 4 netherite scrap + 4 gold ingots. Upgrade at a smithing table.
questbuch.nether.netheritruestung.tun: Get a full set of netherite armor.
questbuch.nether.piglin.schritt.1: Wear some gold so the piglins leave you alone.
questbuch.nether.piglin.schritt.2: Hold a gold ingot and walk up to a piglin.
questbuch.nether.piglin.schritt.3: Toss it and wait a moment: it inspects it and gives you something back.
questbuch.nether.piglin.schritt.4: For example obsidian, soul sand, ender pearls or iron nuggets.
questbuch.nether.piglin.tipp: Toss them a gold ingot and they'll give you something in return.
questbuch.nether.portal.brauchst: 10 obsidian, flint and steel (iron ingot + flint)
questbuch.nether.portal.schritt.1: Collect 10 obsidian, e.g. with a diamond pickaxe.
questbuch.nether.portal.schritt.2: Craft a flint and steel: iron ingot plus flint.
questbuch.nether.portal.schritt.3: Build the frame 4 wide and 5 tall; the corners stay empty.
questbuch.nether.portal.schritt.4: Light the inside and walk through. Note your coordinates!
questbuch.nether.portal.tipp: The frame is 4 wide and 5 tall, corners optional. Note the coordinates!
questbuch.nether.portal.tun: Build a Nether portal, light it and step through.
questbuch.nether.schnellreise.schritt.1: Build a portal in the Overworld and enter the Nether.
questbuch.nether.schnellreise.schritt.2: Walk in one direction in the Nether: 1 block counts as 8 blocks.
questbuch.nether.schnellreise.schritt.3: Just under 900 blocks in the Nether equal 7000 in the Overworld.
questbuch.nether.schnellreise.tipp: 1 block in the Nether is 8 in the Overworld, so about 900 blocks will do.
questbuch.nether.schnellreise.tun: Use the Nether to travel 7 km in the Overworld.
Get a strider, saddle and warped fungus on a stick.
Lure the strider through the portal with the fungus on a stick.
Find an Overworld lava lake and ride 50 blocks across it.
questbuch.nether.schreiter_heim.tipp: Lure it through the portal with the fungus on a stick.
questbuch.nether.schreiter_heim.tun: Ride a strider at least 50 blocks across an Overworld lava lake.
questbuch.nether.schreiter.brauchst: Saddle, warped fungus on a stick (fishing rod + warped fungus)
questbuch.nether.schreiter.fundort.1: Warped fungus grows in the warped forest.
questbuch.nether.schreiter.schritt.1: Craft a saddle from leather and iron, or find one.
questbuch.nether.schreiter.schritt.2: Craft a fishing rod and get a warped fungus from a warped forest.
questbuch.nether.schreiter.schritt.3: Make the warped fungus on a stick: fishing rod plus fungus.
questbuch.nether.schreiter.schritt.4: Saddle a strider on a lava lake, mount it and ride.
questbuch.nether.schreiter.tipp: Striders walk on lava. Perfect for lava lakes.
questbuch.nether.schreiter.tun: Ride a strider with a warped fungus on a stick.
questbuch.nether.schrott.fundort.1: Large veins lie between Y 8 and 24, most commonly around Y 15.
questbuch.nether.schrott.fundort.2: Single pieces also appear higher up, between Y 8 and 120.
questbuch.nether.schrott.schritt.1: Craft a diamond pickaxe: only it mines ancient debris.
questbuch.nether.schrott.schritt.2: Go to the Nether and dig a tunnel at about Y 15.
questbuch.nether.schrott.schritt.3: Look for ancient debris and mine it.
questbuch.nether.schrott.tipp: Most common around Y 15. It survives explosions.
questbuch.nether.seelenanker.brauchst: Respawn anchor: 6 crying obsidian, 3 glowstone. Plus 4 glowstone to charge
questbuch.nether.seelenanker.schritt.2: Put 3 crying obsidian each on top and bottom, 3 glowstone in the middle.
questbuch.nether.seelenanker.schritt.3: Place it in the Nether and use glowstone on it 4 times.
questbuch.nether.seelenanker.schritt.4: Only in the Nether! In the Overworld it explodes.
questbuch.nether.seelenanker.tipp: It's the Nether's bed. In the Overworld it explodes!
questbuch.nether.seelenanker.tun: Charge a respawn anchor to the max.
questbuch.nether.trank.brauchst: Brewing stand: 1 blaze rod, 3 cobblestone. Plus water bottles, nether wart, blaze powder
questbuch.nether.trank.fundort.1: Nether wart grows on soul sand in Nether fortresses.
questbuch.nether.trank.schritt.1: Craft a brewing stand from the blaze rod and 3 cobblestone.
questbuch.nether.trank.schritt.2: Turn a blaze rod into blaze powder: that's the fuel.
questbuch.nether.trank.schritt.3: Get nether wart from the fortress and fill water bottles.
questbuch.nether.trank.schritt.4: Put wart on top and bottles below in the brewing stand: potion done.
questbuch.nether.trank.tipp: Nether wart grows on soul sand in fortresses. Blaze powder is the fuel.
questbuch.nether.weinender_obsidian.fund: Bastion remnants hold crying obsidian in their chests.
questbuch.nether.weinender_obsidian.schr: Barter gold ingots with piglins: sometimes you get crying obsidian.
Or look for it in bastion remnants and ruined portals.
Mine it with a diamond pickaxe.
questbuch.nether.weinender_obsidian.tipp: Piglins barter it for gold. It's also in bastions and ruined portals.
questbuch.nether.wither.brauchst: 3 wither skeleton skulls, 4 soul sand or soul soil
questbuch.nether.wither.schritt.1: Gather 3 wither skeleton skulls and 4 soul sand or soul soil.
questbuch.nether.wither.schritt.2: Pick a spot far away from homes and spawn.
questbuch.nether.wither.schritt.3: Place 4 soul sand in a T shape with the 3 skulls on top.
questbuch.nether.wither.schritt.4: The Wither awakens: fight together and keep your distance.
questbuch.nether.wither.tipp: Far away from homes and spawn, please! Best done together, deep underground.
Wither skeletons live in Nether fortresses.
Head to a Nether fortress and look for wither skeletons.
Enchant your sword with Looting to improve your odds.
Defeat wither skeletons until a wither skeleton skull drops.
questbuch.nether.witherschaedel.tipp: Wither skeletons live in fortresses. Looting improves your odds.
questbuch.tiere.alle_tiere.fundort.1: Hoglins live in the Nether, in the Crimson Forest.
questbuch.tiere.alle_tiere.schritt.1: Start with the familiar ones: cow, sheep, pig, chicken.
questbuch.tiere.alle_tiere.schritt.2: For each new kind, check its favourite food, e.g. wheat for goats.
questbuch.tiere.alle_tiere.schritt.3: Hoglins want crimson fungus, striders want warped fungus.
questbuch.tiere.alle_tiere.schritt.4: Keep count: there are 26 kinds, so bring patience.
questbuch.tiere.alle_tiere.tipp: Hoglins and striders count too, so you'll need the Nether. One for the patient.
questbuch.tiere.angeln.schritt.1: Craft a fishing rod from 3 sticks and 2 string.
questbuch.tiere.angeln.schritt.2: Stand by the water and cast the rod with right-click.
questbuch.tiere.angeln.schritt.3: Wait patiently until the bobber dips.
questbuch.tiere.angeln.schritt.4: Right-click now and the fish flops into your inventory. Rain helps the bites.
questbuch.tiere.angeln.tipp: Wait for the bobber to dip, then right-click. Fish bite faster in the rain.
questbuch.tiere.axolotl_kampf.schritt.1: Release your axolotl in water where water mobs swim.
questbuch.tiere.axolotl_kampf.schritt.2: Stay close: it attacks water mobs on its own.
questbuch.tiere.axolotl_kampf.schritt.3: When the enemy falls, you get Regeneration as a reward.
questbuch.tiere.axolotl_kampf.tipp: Axolotls attack water mobs. When the enemy falls, you get Regeneration.
questbuch.tiere.axolotl_kampf.tun: Team up with an axolotl and win a fight.
questbuch.tiere.axolotl.fundort.1: Axolotls swim in ponds of lush caves.
questbuch.tiere.axolotl.schritt.2: Look for a pond in a lush cave.
questbuch.tiere.axolotl.schritt.3: Right-click the axolotl with the bucket and it's yours.
questbuch.tiere.axolotl.tipp: Axolotls live underwater in lush caves.
questbuch.tiere.axolotl.tun: Catch an axolotl in a water bucket.
questbuch.tiere.beschreibung: Breed, tame, fish. And yes, you may keep them all.
questbuch.tiere.eimerfisch.fundort.2: Salmon swim in rivers and cold oceans.
questbuch.tiere.eimerfisch.schritt.1: Craft a bucket from 3 iron ingots and fill it at water.
questbuch.tiere.eimerfisch.schritt.2: Head to water where fish swim, e.g. in the ocean.
questbuch.tiere.eimerfisch.schritt.3: Right-click a fish with the water bucket and it's in the bucket.
questbuch.tiere.eimerfisch.tipp: Right-click a swimming fish with a water bucket.
questbuch.tiere.eimerfisch.tun: Catch a fish without a fishing rod.
questbuch.tiere.froesche.fundort.1: Temperate frog: swamp. Warm frog: mangrove swamp, desert, jungle, savanna.
questbuch.tiere.froesche.fundort.2: Cold frog: e.g. snowy plains, snowy taiga, grove.
questbuch.tiere.froesche.schritt.1: Make 3 leads. Crafting gives you two at a time.
questbuch.tiere.froesche.schritt.2: The swamp gives the temperate frog, the mangrove swamp the warm one.
questbuch.tiere.froesche.schritt.3: For the cold frog, carry a bucketed tadpole to a cold biome, e.g. snowy plains.
questbuch.tiere.froesche.schritt.4: Wait until it grows into a frog there, then lead it.
questbuch.tiere.froesche.tipp: The colour depends on where the tadpole grows up: cold, temperate or warm.
questbuch.tiere.froesche.tun: Put each of the 3 frog variants on a lead once.
questbuch.tiere.guerteltier.fundort.1: Armadillos live in savannas and badlands.
questbuch.tiere.guerteltier.schritt.1: Craft a brush: feather on top, copper ingot in the middle, stick at the bottom.
questbuch.tiere.guerteltier.schritt.2: Find an armadillo in a savanna or badlands.
questbuch.tiere.guerteltier.schritt.3: Sneak up slowly or it curls into a ball.
questbuch.tiere.guerteltier.schritt.4: Hold right-click with the brush until the scute drops.
questbuch.tiere.guerteltier.tipp: Armadillos live in savannas and badlands. Approach slowly or they roll up.
questbuch.tiere.guerteltier.tun: Brush a scute off an armadillo.
questbuch.tiere.hilfsgeist_kuchen.schrit: Craft a cake from 3 milk buckets, 2 sugar, 1 egg and 3 wheat.
Craft a note block from 8 planks and 1 redstone dust.
Play the note block with right-click and the allay drops the cake there.
questbuch.tiere.hilfsgeist_kuchen.tipp: When a note block plays, the allay brings its loot there. Happy birthday!
questbuch.tiere.hilfsgeist_kuchen.tun: Have an allay drop a cake at a note block.
questbuch.tiere.hilfsgeist.fundort.1: Allays sit in cages at pillager outposts and in woodland mansions.
questbuch.tiere.hilfsgeist.schritt.1: Find an allay in a pillager outpost or woodland mansion.
questbuch.tiere.hilfsgeist.schritt.2: Hand it an item with right-click, e.g. wheat seeds.
questbuch.tiere.hilfsgeist.schritt.3: It collects matching items. Walk a bit away and wait for it to bring them.
questbuch.tiere.hilfsgeist.tipp: Allays live in pillager outposts and woodland mansions. Hand one an item and it collects more of it.
questbuch.tiere.hilfsgeist.tun: Have an allay deliver an item to you.
questbuch.tiere.katzen.fundort.1: Strays in villages: plains, meadow, desert, savanna, taiga, snowy plains.
questbuch.tiere.katzen.schritt.2: Look for strays in villages. Walk slowly or they dash off.
questbuch.tiere.katzen.schritt.3: Feed the cat fish until hearts appear: it's yours.
questbuch.tiere.katzen.schritt.4: For the black cat, look for a swamp hut (witch hut).
questbuch.tiere.katzen.schritt.5: Visit more villages until every coat pattern is in your collection.
questbuch.tiere.katzen.tipp: Strays live in villages, black cats near witch huts.
questbuch.tiere.kaulquappe.fundort.1: Frogs live in swamps and mangrove swamps.
questbuch.tiere.kaulquappe.schritt.1: Find frogs in a swamp and feed two of them slimeballs.
questbuch.tiere.kaulquappe.schritt.2: They lay frogspawn in the water, and tadpoles hatch from it.
questbuch.tiere.kaulquappe.schritt.3: Right-click a tadpole with a water bucket.
questbuch.tiere.kaulquappe.tipp: Tadpoles hatch from frogspawn. Frogs live in swamps.
questbuch.tiere.kaulquappe.tun: Catch a tadpole in a water bucket.
questbuch.tiere.papagei.fundort.1: Parrots live in jungles and bamboo jungles.
questbuch.tiere.papagei.schritt.1: Craft a spyglass: amethyst shard on top, 2 copper ingots below.
questbuch.tiere.papagei.schritt.2: Find a parrot in a jungle.
questbuch.tiere.papagei.schritt.3: Hold right-click with the spyglass and look at it.
questbuch.tiere.papagei.tipp: Parrots live in jungles. Seeds tame them.
questbuch.tiere.papagei.tun: Look at a parrot through a spyglass.
Sulfur cubes live in the sulfur caves.
Craft TNT from 5 gunpowder and 4 sand.
Find an adult sulfur cube in the sulfur caves.
Hand it the TNT with right-click or throw it over.
Now keep your distance, or it gets loud!
questbuch.tiere.schwefelwuerfel.tipp: Sulfur cubes live in sulfur caves. Hand it the TNT or throw it over, then keep your distance!
questbuch.tiere.schwefelwuerfel.tun: Have an adult sulfur cube pick up a block of TNT.
questbuch.tiere.woelfe.fundort.1: Woods wolf: forest. Spotted wolf: savanna plateau. Rusty wolf: sparse jungle.
questbuch.tiere.woelfe.fundort.2: Ashen wolf: snowy taiga. Black wolf: old growth pine taiga. Chestnut wolf: old growth spruce taiga.
questbuch.tiere.woelfe.fundort.3: Snowy wolf: grove. Striped wolf: wooded badlands. Pale wolf: taiga.
questbuch.tiere.woelfe.schritt.1: Pack a whole stack of bones.
questbuch.tiere.woelfe.schritt.2: Travel from biome to biome: each wolf kind lives in a different one.
questbuch.tiere.woelfe.schritt.3: Tame one wolf there with bones and tick the kind off.
questbuch.tiere.woelfe.schritt.4: Typical places: forest, taiga, jungle, savanna, badlands, grove.
questbuch.tiere.woelfe.tipp: There are 9 wolf variants, each in a different biome.
questbuch.tiere.wolfspanzer_ab.brauchst: Shears, a tamed wolf wearing wolf armor
questbuch.tiere.wolfspanzer_ab.schritt.1: Craft 6 scutes into wolf armor (pattern in the recipe book).
questbuch.tiere.wolfspanzer_ab.schritt.2: Right-click a tamed wolf to put the armor on.
questbuch.tiere.wolfspanzer_ab.schritt.4: Right-click the wolf with shears: armor off, wolf happy.
questbuch.tiere.wolfspanzer_ab.tipp: Wolf armor is made from 6 armadillo scutes.
questbuch.tiere.wolfspanzer_ab.tun: Remove a wolf's armor with shears.
questbuch.tiere.wolfspanzer_flicken.schr: Put the armor on your wolf and let it fight until it gets dented.
Right-click the wolf, each scute patches a bit. Repeat until it's whole.
questbuch.tiere.wolfspanzer_flicken.tipp: Right-click the wolf with scutes, each one patches a bit.
questbuch.tiere.zaehmen.brauchst: e.g. bones for wolves, raw fish for cats
questbuch.tiere.zaehmen.fundort.1: Wolves live in forests and taigas.
questbuch.tiere.zaehmen.schritt.1: Find a wolf or a cat. Wolves live in forests, for example.
questbuch.tiere.zaehmen.schritt.2: Hold bones for the wolf or raw fish for the cat.
questbuch.tiere.zaehmen.schritt.3: Right-click to feed it until red hearts appear. It may take a few tries.
questbuch.tiere.zaehmen.schritt.4: Right-click without food to make it sit or follow again.
questbuch.tiere.zaehmen.tipp: Tamed animals follow you. Right-click to make them sit.
questbuch.tiere.ziege.brauchst: Boat, a lead or wheat to lure it
questbuch.tiere.ziege.fundort.1: Goats live on snowy mountain peaks and slopes.
questbuch.tiere.ziege.schritt.1: Craft a boat from 5 planks, e.g. oak.
questbuch.tiere.ziege.schritt.2: Bring wheat or a lead to lure the goat.
questbuch.tiere.ziege.schritt.3: Find a goat high in the mountains. Don't stand too close: it loves to ram!
questbuch.tiere.ziege.schritt.4: Lead it to a boat on the water and set off together.
questbuch.tiere.ziege.tipp: Goats live high in the mountains. Careful, they love to ram.
questbuch.tiere.ziege.tun: Take a goat for a boat ride.
questbuch.tiere.zuechten.brauchst: Wheat for cows and sheep, carrots for pigs, seeds for chickens
questbuch.tiere.zuechten.fundort.1: Cows, sheep, pigs and chickens live in plains and forests.
questbuch.tiere.zuechten.schritt.1: Find two animals of the same kind, e.g. two cows.
questbuch.tiere.zuechten.schritt.2: Hold their food: wheat for cows and sheep, carrots for pigs.
questbuch.tiere.zuechten.schritt.3: Right-click both to feed them until hearts appear.
questbuch.tiere.zuechten.schritt.4: Congratulations, it's a baby! It takes a while to grow up.
questbuch.tiere.zuechten.tipp: The parents need a 5-minute break afterwards.
